name: [2X💰] SCP retroBreach
desc:
Welcome to SCP retroBreach! Join the game and play as an SCP Anomaly, Security Guard, Task Force Agent, or a Prisoner! Two goals, escape and survive! 

⭐ Earn TIX to purchase new skins to play as or buy them with Robux in the shop! (Don't worry, it's not pay to win and skins are only cosmetic!)

📊 Rack up kills, points, escapes, and wins to flex on other players!

👍 Like and favorite the game and join Sandbox Engine!

Game is currently in Beta. You may encounter bugs or balancing issues!
